description: Manages the creation, retrieval, update, deletion, and testing of AI prompt templates and their configurations. This entity allows users to define, organize, and manage reusable AI prompts for various models and use cases.

endpoints.name: GetPromptsAsync
endpoints.description: Retrieves all AI prompts with advanced filtering, pagination, search capabilities, and access control for prompt management.

request.description: AI prompt filter request containing search and pagination parameters

example_uses: Find prompts containing 'email' in the name
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this when the user asks to search, list, filter, or browse AI prompts and prompt templates.

endpoints.name: GetPromptByIdAsync
endpoints.description: Retrieves a specific AI prompt by ID with complete details including prompt content, parameters, and configuration.
example_uses: Show me details for AI prompt ID 123
Show prompt with all parameters and content
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this when the user asks for specific AI prompt details by ID or when you need complete prompt information for editing or testing.

endpoints.name: CreatePromptAsync
endpoints.description: Creates a new AI prompt with complete configuration including content, parameters, model settings, and metadata.

model.description: AI prompt creation request with all configuration details

example_uses: Create a new email generation prompt
Add a customer service response template
Set up a new data analysis prompt
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this when the user asks to create, add, or set up a new AI prompt template.

endpoints.name: UpdatePromptAsync
endpoints.description: Updates an existing AI prompt's configuration including content, parameters, model settings, and metadata.
example_uses: Update prompt 123's content with new template
Change prompt 456's model from GPT-3.5 to GPT-4
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this when the user asks to update, modify, edit, or change AI prompt configuration or content.

endpoints.name: DeletePromptAsync
endpoints.description: Soft deletes an AI prompt from the system (marks as deleted rather than permanent removal).
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this when the user asks to delete, remove, or eliminate an AI prompt.

endpoints.name: GetPromptsByTypeAsync
endpoints.description: Retrieves all AI prompts filtered by specific prompt type with access control.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this when the user asks to filter prompts by specific type, category, or functional purpose.

endpoints.name: GetPromptTypesAsync
endpoints.description: Retrieves all unique prompt types available in the system for dropdown menus and filtering operations.
example_uses: Get prompt types for dropdown menu
What types of prompts are available?
Get filter options for prompt types
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this when the user needs to see available prompt types for filtering or when building UI dropdown menus.

endpoints.name: GetModelsAsync
endpoints.description: Retrieves all unique AI models available in the system for dropdown menus and filtering operations.
example_uses: Get AI models for dropdown menu
Get filter options for AI models
List GPT and other model options
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this when the user needs to see available AI models for filtering or when configuring prompt model settings.

endpoints.name: GetProjectsAsync
endpoints.description: Retrieves all unique projects associated with AI prompts for dropdown menus and filtering operations.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this when the user needs to see available projects for filtering prompts or when assigning prompts to projects.

endpoints.name: GetLocationsAsync
endpoints.description: Retrieves all unique locations/regions associated with AI prompts for dropdown menus and filtering operations.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this when the user needs to see available locations for filtering prompts or when assigning prompts to regions.

endpoints.name: TestPromptAsync
endpoints.description: Tests an AI prompt with provided test data to validate prompt effectiveness and output quality before deployment.

request.description: Test request containing prompt data and test parameters

example_uses: Test email prompt with sample data
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this when the user wants to test, validate, or preview AI prompt output before using it in production.
